gw_rename.done_dup: The same name is also used by: {ids}.
gw_rename.note.forward: The forwarding rules do not change.
gw_rename.note.inbound: The protocol settings and the keys given out do not change.
gw_rename.note.profile: The connection works as before. The profile name in the app stays the same until you set it up again.
gw_rename.note.same: The key and the settings do not change.
gw_rename.note.sub: The name changes in the app at the next subscription update.
gw_rename.note.user: The user’s page and the subscription title show the new name. Device logins do not change.
gw_rename.note.wg: The app keeps the old name until you issue the settings again. A new .conf file or QR code adds a second tunnel with the same keys in the WireGuard or AmneziaWG app — delete the old tunnel in the app.
gw_rename.sub_ambiguous: Several subscriptions have the label “{ref}” ({ids}) — give the number or the id.
gw_rename.subs_broken: The file of the exit subscriptions is damaged — renaming is not possible. Check the subscriptions in the exits menu.
